title: Topic category icons: opendata-explorer Discover

roles.note: Drawn on the rim of each top-level circle in the circle-pack, 18px in the category's own green. A new family beside the rail and status icons: same Phosphor grammar, no shared frame. Four are visible with the cached catalogue; the live catalogue can show all eleven.

items.reading: The organic part, not a place: a leaf, so Public Space can keep the park.
Metonymy for Basel: the BVB tram, not a generic car.
The built fabric; the crane only covers construction.
A place you go to, distinct from the leaf of Environment.
A vital sign; first-aid reads as emergency.
The institution; a book overlaps with culture/library.
Theatre and events; a museum column would be confused with Government's bank.
The public institution (columns); scales would say justice only.
Not yet sorted; avoids ? which already means unresolved.

questions: Topic lens only, or also the Space lens (Point / Line / Polygon / Raster / Non-spatial), which maps naturally to icons?
Mobility as tram (Basel-specific) or bicycle (the running/cycling use cases)?
Subcategories (≈40) stay without icons: at that depth icons would be decoration, not recognition. Agreed?
